image_description: A close-up shot of a child's arm holding a yellow bubble wand, blowing soap bubbles. Several bubbles are visible in mid-air against a background of yellow siding and a green window frame. A small yellow rubber duck is attached to the wand. The back of another person's head with curly brown hair is visible in the foreground.
